name: @<scope>/<module>
description: Modulo <module> — fatia vertical autossuficiente (contrato + core + api + web).

scripts.//coverage: So aqui, nunca no `test`: escreve reports/coverage/lcov.info (SonarQube/Codecov) e reports/junit.xml (CI). `coverage:check` reprova se o relatorio nao existir ou vier degenerado (ferramenta que 'passou' sem medir nada) — lei 7 aplicada ao relatorio, nao so ao exit code do vitest.
scripts.coverage:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const targets=[['reports/coverage/lcov.info','SF:'],['reports/junit.xml','<testsuite']];for(const [p,marker] of targets){if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('report missing: '+p);process.exit(1)}const t=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!t.includes(marker)){console.error('degenerate report (no '+marker+'): '+p);process.exit(1)}}const m=fs.readFileSync('reports/junit.xml','utf8').match(/tests=\"(\d+)\"/);if(!m||Number(m[1])===0){console.error('junit has no test recorded — the suite did not run');process.exit(1)}console.log('reports OK: lcov + junit present, not degenerate, '+m[1]+' test(s)')"
